label: CROSS-PROJECT-RESOURCE-LOCK-V2
title: Adopt the shared local and GamePC lock protocol with adaptive local resource limits
scope: Make the cross-project resource-lock wrapper authoritative for local heavy jobs and GamePC stages, replace the fixed local 16 GiB/50% ceiling with an audited task-specific policy after exclusive acquisition, and preserve strict heavy-job serialization and interactive-system safety.
reads: existing task resource records as historical evidence

validation.external_lock: bash syntax plus isolated concurrency, close-inherited-fd, exit propagation, optional admission and dual-lock tests
validation.repository: git diff --check, JSON parse and task timestamp checker scoped to the new task

acceptance: All future local and GamePC heavy entries acquire the corresponding shared lock; local lock ownership removes the mandatory fixed 16 GiB/50% cap but does not remove task-specific admission, evidence or protection of interactive processes; existing evidence remains immutable.
resource: Documentation and isolated lightweight self-test only; do not acquire a production lock or start a heavy job.
